originalScripts.ServerScriptService.BrokenDreamsLobbyAPI:
-- API exclusiva del servidor. No inicia partidas ni asigna asesino.
local state=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("BrokenDreamsLobbyState")
local API={}
local function imageId(value)
 assert(type(value)=="string" and (value=="" or value:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$")), "Usa rbxassetid://ID o una cadena vacía")
 return value
end
function API.SetCountdown(seconds)
 assert(type(seconds)=="number" and seconds==seconds and seconds<math.huge and (seconds==-1 or seconds>=0),"Tiempo inválido")
 state:SetAttribute("RemainingSeconds",seconds==-1 and -1 or math.floor(seconds))
end
function API.SetNextMap(name,asset)
 assert(type(name)=="string","Nombre inválido")
 local checked=imageId(asset)
 state:SetAttribute("NextMapImage",checked);state:SetAttribute("NextMapName",name)
end
function API.SetPortrait(characterName,asset)
 local portraits=state:FindFirstChild("Portraits")
 characterName=characterName:gsub(" ","_")
 assert(portraits:GetAttribute(characterName)~=nil,"Superviviente desconocido")
 portraits:SetAttribute(characterName,imageId(asset))
end
-- Mayor malicia obligatoria. Empate: menor UserId; nunca se usa azar.
-- Devuelve nil si faltan datos: nunca escoge arbitrariamente por defecto.
function API.GetHighestMalice(players,readMalice)
 assert(type(readMalice)=="function","Proporciona la función que lee tu malicia autoritativa")
 local best,bestValue=nil,-math.huge
 for _,player in ipairs(players) do
  local value=readMalice(player)
  if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then
   return nil,"Malicia no disponible para "..player.Name
  end
  if value>bestValue or (value==bestValue and (not best or player.UserId<best.UserId)) then best=player;bestValue=value end
 end
 return best,bestValue
end
function API.RefreshMalicia(players,readMalice)
 local player,value=API.GetHighestMalice(players,readMalice)
 if not player then
  state:SetAttribute("MaliciaUserId",0);state:SetAttribute("MaliciaName","POR DETERMINAR");state:SetAttribute("MaliciaValue",0)
  return nil,value
 end
 state:SetAttribute("MaliciaValue",value);state:SetAttribute("MaliciaName",player.DisplayName);state:SetAttribute("MaliciaUserId",player.UserId)
 return player,value
end
return API
originalScripts.ServerScriptService.BrokenDreamsLobbySer:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local state=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("BrokenDreamsLobbyState")
local lobby=workspace:WaitForChild("BrokenDreamsLobby")
local portraits=state:WaitForChild("Portraits")
local function guiFor(model)
 local surface=model:FindFirstChild("DisplaySurface",true)
 return surface and surface:FindFirstChild("Display")
end
local malicia=guiFor(lobby.MaliciaBoard)
local map=guiFor(lobby.NextMapBoard)
local requestVersion=0
local function updateMalicia()
 requestVersion+=1;local thisRequest=requestVersion
 malicia.Detail.Text=state:GetAttribute("MaliciaName") or "POR DETERMINAR"
 malicia.Portrait.Image="";malicia.Placeholder.Visible=true
 local id=state:GetAttribute("MaliciaUserId") or 0
 if id>0 then
  task.spawn(function()
   local ok,image,ready=pcall(Players.GetUserThumbnailAsync,Players,id,Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarBust,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
   if ok and ready and requestVersion==thisRequest then malicia.Portrait.Image=image;malicia.Placeholder.Visible=false end
  end)
 end
end
local function updateMap()
 map.Detail.Text=state:GetAttribute("NextMapName") or "MAPA PENDIENTE"
 map.Portrait.Image=state:GetAttribute("NextMapImage") or ""
 map.Placeholder.Visible=map.Portrait.Image==""
end
for _,key in ipairs({"MaliciaName","MaliciaUserId"}) do state:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(updateMalicia) end
for _,key in ipairs({"NextMapName","NextMapImage"}) do state:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(updateMap) end
updateMap();updateMalicia()
for _,model in ipairs(lobby.CharacterGallery:GetChildren()) do
 local display=guiFor(model)
 if display then
  local name=model:GetAttribute("CharacterName"):gsub(" ","_")
  local function refresh() display.Portrait.Image=portraits:GetAttribute(name) or "";display.Placeholder.Visible=display.Portrait.Image=="" end
  portraits:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(refresh);refresh()
 end
end
local function joined(player)
 if state:GetAttribute("AssignLobbySpawn") then player.RespawnLocation=lobby.PlayerSpawns.LobbySpawn end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(joined)
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do joined(player) end
-- No bucle de cuenta atrás: el futuro RoundService llamará a API.SetCountdown.
originalScripts.StarterGui.BrokenDreamsLobbyHUD.LobbyHUD:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local state=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("BrokenDreamsLobbyState")
local gui=script.Parent
local timer=gui.Panel.Time
local oldCamera=nil
local function update()
 local seconds=state:GetAttribute("RemainingSeconds") or -1
 timer.Text=seconds<0 and "—:—" or string.format("%02d:%02d",math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60)
end
state:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RemainingSeconds"):Connect(update);update()
local elapsed=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed+=dt;if elapsed<.25 then return end;elapsed=0
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local origin=state:GetAttribute("Origin")
 local p=root and origin and root.Position-origin
 local boundsMin=state:GetAttribute("LobbyBoundsMin") or Vector3.new(-38,-3,-32)
 local boundsMax=state:GetAttribute("LobbyBoundsMax") or Vector3.new(38,34,35)
 local inside=p~=nil and p.X>boundsMin.X and p.X<boundsMax.X and p.Y>boundsMin.Y and p.Y<boundsMax.Y and p.Z>boundsMin.Z and p.Z<boundsMax.Z
 gui.Enabled=inside
 if inside and not oldCamera then
  oldCamera={player.CameraMode,player.CameraMinZoomDistance,player.CameraMaxZoomDistance}
  player.CameraMode=Enum.CameraMode.Classic
  player.CameraMinZoomDistance=6;player.CameraMaxZoomDistance=24
 elseif not inside and oldCamera then
  player.CameraMode=oldCamera[1]
  -- Reset min first so restoring a smaller maximum never clamps incorrectly.
  player.CameraMinZoomDistance=0.5;player.CameraMaxZoomDistance=oldCamera[3];player.CameraMinZoomDistance=oldCamera[2]
  oldCamera=nil
 end
end)
